name: Vox Doc
tagline: charlie947's vox-explainer: torn paper documentary — red, cream, navy, a yellow accent — stepped on twos, cards not lines.

motion.direction: charlie947 vox-explainer. Palette strictly red `ter`, cream `mar`, navy `stage` with a yellow `gold` accent; bold condensed Oswald type set as blocks; kinetic statements of three short lines on a torn paper strip (`posterText`); torn-edge paper `imageCard`s dropping in with small shadows; before / after with a date chip flip (`chips`); a marker circle that draws itself (`focusRing`); `counter`s; a grid where one card breaks (`strikeLine`). STEPPED motion, on twos — hold each pose 2 frames, never smooth corporate easing; 8–14 shots of one sentence each, shot 1 is the question, the first surprise within 5 s, the last shot a takeaway ≤ 5 words. Score: low bed, a hit on each new shot. No typewriter, no glow, no gradients.
